shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git log --oneline -3
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -50
find /workspace/app /workspace/lib /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts
ls -R node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | head -80
for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/catalog/page.tsx lib/data.ts __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat -n "$f"; done
cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md

wc -l node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route-segment-config/instant.md 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/

ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/ | grep -iE 'prefetch|cache'; echo "---"; grep -rn "partialPrefetching" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -20
sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md 2>/dev/null
grep -n "prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -40
sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40
(npm start > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; tail -5 /tmp/start.log
grep -rnoE '"Next-Router-Prefetch"|NEXT_ROUTER_PREFETCH_HEADER|NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER[^,]{0,40}' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js | head
sed -n '90,120p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js

cd /tmp && echo "=== plain prefetch (rsc+next-router-prefetch) ===" && curl -s -H 'rsc: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale' -D /tmp/h1.txt -o /tmp/p1.txt; grep -iE 'x-nextjs|content-type' /tmp/h1.txt; echo "--- payload matches:"; grep -coE 'Canvas Tote|Products on sale|Loading category' /tmp/p1.txt; for s in "Canvas Tote" "Products on sale" "Loading category"; do printf '%s: %s\n' "$s" "$(grep -c "$s" /tmp/p1.txt)"; done
head -c 400 /tmp/h1.txt; echo; echo "=== body size ==="; wc -c /tmp/p1.txt

curl -sL -H 'rsc: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale' -o /tmp/p1.txt -D /tmp/h1.txt; grep -iE 'x-nextjs|content-type' /tmp/h1.txt; wc -c /tmp/p1.txt; for s in "Canvas Tote" "Products on sale" "Loading category"; do printf '%s: %s\n' "$s" "$(grep -c "$s" /tmp/p1.txt)"; done
npm view @next/playwright version 2>&1 | tail -2
npm install -D @next/playwright @playwright/test 2>&1 | tail -3 && npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5

curl -s -o /tmp/p2.txt -w 'status=%{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n' -H 'rsc: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale&_rsc=HEAvJdHAQJrUAe2K'; for s in "Canvas Tote" "Products on sale" "Loading category"; do printf '%s: %s\n' "$s" "$(grep -c "$s" /tmp/p2.txt)"; done
pkill -f 'next start' ; pkill -f 'next-server' ; sleep 1; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
npx playwright test 2>&1 | tail -40
(sudo -n npx playwright install-deps chromium 2>&1 || npx playwright install-deps chromium 2>&1) | tail -6
which dnf yum microdnf apk pacman 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -3
sudo -n dnf install -y nspr nss nss-util atk at-spi2-atk at-spi2-core cups-libs libdrm libxkbcommon libXcomposite libXdamage libXfixes libXrandr mesa-libgbm alsa-lib pango 2>&1 | tail -5
npx playwright test 2>&1 | tail -30

sed -i 's| prefetch={true}||' app/page.tsx && npm run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx playwright test 2>&1 | grep -E '✓|✘|passed|failed|Loading category|toHaveCount|Expected|Received' | head -8; sed -i 's|href={`/catalog?category=${category.slug}`}|href={`/catalog?category=${category.slug}`} prefetch={true}|' app/page.tsx; grep -n 'prefetch' app/page.tsx
ps aux | grep -E 'next|node' | grep -v grep | head
kill 452; sleep 1; ps aux | grep next-server | grep -v grep | wc -l
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E 'Compiled|error' ; npx playwright test 2>&1 | tail -20

sed -i 's| prefetch={true}||' app/page.tsx && grep -n Link app/page.tsx | head -3 && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E 'Compiled|error'; npx playwright test 2>&1 | grep -vE '^\s+-|browserType|<launch' | tail -25

sed -i 's|href={`/catalog?category=${category.slug}`}|href={`/catalog?category=${category.slug}`} prefetch={true}|' app/page.tsx && sed -i "/^  'use cache'$/d" lib/data.ts && cat lib/data.ts && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E 'Compiled|error'; npx playwright test 2>&1 | grep -E 'passed|failed|Expected substring|element\(s\) not found' | head
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E 'Compiled|error'; npx playwright test 2>&1 | tail -6

(npm start > /tmp/s2.log 2>&1 &); sleep 5; for c in featured sale; do echo "== /catalog?category=$c"; curl -s "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=$c" | grep -oE 'Products on sale|Featured products|Desk Lamp|Wool Blanket|Canvas Tote|Travel Mug|Loading category\.\.\.' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done; echo "== / "; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oE 'href="/catalog\?category=[a-z]+"' | sort -u
git diff --stat; echo "=== package.json diff ==="; git diff package.json; echo "=== gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore; echo "=== untracked ==="; git status --short

pkill -f next-server; rm -rf test-results; cat >> .gitignore <<'EOF'
.next/
next-env.d.ts
test-results/
playwright-report/
EOF
node -e "const p=require('./package.json');p.scripts['test:e2e']='playwright test';require('fs').writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n')" ; cat .gitignore; grep -A6 '"scripts"' package.json

rm -rf test-results; printf '.next/
next-env.d.ts
test-results/
playwright-report/
' >> .gitignore; node -e "const p=require('./package.json');p.scripts['test:e2e']='playwright test';require('fs').writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'
')"; cat .gitignore; grep -A7 '"scripts"' package.json
ps aux | grep next-server | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r kill; sleep 1; rm -rf .next; npm run test:e2e 2>&1 | tail -8
ps aux | grep next-server | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r kill; git --no-pager diff -- app lib next.config.ts .gitignore
